scope: Existing v5 guard, editor helper, frontend; proposed TEST01/JUOG-971 extension
findings: v5 scope, runtime config, frontend CASE and fixture hashes exclusively pin JUOG-970. A generic two-case allowlist would permit new 970 writes, contradicting the latest PI restriction.
Old negative helper pins the pre-negative 58-row journal. Current baseline must be freshly read and pinned, not replaced merely to bypass a mismatch.
Fixture970 initialization assumes an empty baseline and revision0. A global text substitution is unsafe for971 in the populated journal.

New971 initialization must use the existing append-only domain service, fixed setup operation ID, actual setup timestamp, fixed synthetic business dates, exclusive ScriptLock, and before/after verification of every pre-existing table/record.

Mode enable must require confirmed backup, reviewed exact source/deployment, actual review evidence reference, unchanged verified one-person facility ACL, and current journal baseline. Readiness must have no side effects.
Request preparation, execution, status and read paths must all apply the same971-only scope and reauthorize saved operations. No legacy direct-write path or actor spoofing.
Existing session signing, replay checks, per-physical-write expiry and ACL rechecks must remain byte-identical outside the minimal approved scope change.

Failure or ambiguous acknowledgement must halt; retain operation_id and query status. Do not generate a new operation to hide an uncertain save. Return to AUTH_CONNECT and verify readback after the batch.
